sloka: तं विना केकयीपुत्रं भरतं धर्मचारिणम् ।न मे स्नानं बहुमतं वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च ।। ६.१२४.७ ।।
transliteration: taṁ vinā kekayīputraṁ bharataṁ dharmacāriṇam ।na me snānaṁ bahumataṁ vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ।। 6.124.7 ।।

translations.english: "Mighty armed Bharata, righteous, giving up comforts of delicate body, resorting to truth is distressed for my cause."
